pathAssistantSteps.info:
Active — BAN is approved and ready for billing.

  • Orders can now be linked to this BAN
  • BAN syncs to Odoo for invoicing

Draft — BAN being configured.

  • Set DE Subsidiary, billing contact, and invoice frequency
  • Confirm all billing details are correct
  • Submit for Approval when ready

Pending Approval — awaiting Finance review.

  • Finance reviews billing details and DE Subsidiary
  • Approval or rejection sent to submitter
